items.summary: 11月5日，百度正式开源最新基座模型文心5.5 Flash Base

extra.evidence: 11月5日，百度正式开源最新基座模型文心5.5 Flash Base 11月5日，百度正式开源最新基座模型文心5.5 Flash Base（ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base）。模型采用MoE架构，总参数量2800亿，每个 Token 激活140亿参数，使用33.5万亿个 Token 完成预训练，预训练上下文长度最高达128K，微调与推理阶段支持最长100万 Token上下文。在知识、推理、数学、代码、多语言和长上下文等多个基准测试中取得同尺寸模型 SOTA 表现，超过 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base、Hy3-preview-Base、MiMo-V2.5-Base 等模型。 开源地址：https://huggingface.co/baidu/ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base 随着大模型应用从文本问答向长文档分析、多轮交互和智能体任务延伸，模型需要处理的信息量持续增加，计算和显存开销也随之上升。在保证模型能力的同时提高资源利用效率，已成为大模型研发的重要课题。 文心 5.5 Flash Base围绕“效率”这一设计主线，在注意力机制、专家路由及训练机制等关键环节进行系统性优化，并实现了多项算法创新。 在注意力机制上，文心提出 Latent-Gated Sparse Attention ，将混合稀疏注意力、低秩门控注意力与虚拟头注意力结合起来。其中，模型通过组合HCA与MLA，让不同注意力层分别承担压缩历史信息和细粒度访问历史位置的任务；低秩门控注意力（Low-Rank Gated Attention）则利用已有的低维表示计算信息门控，使门控投影权重参数减少75%；此外，虚拟头注意力（Virtual Head Attention，VHA）可提升模型表达力与训练质量，推理时融合进注意力算子，开销极小。这些设计降低了长上下文处理的资源开销，同时保留模型…

items.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
items.summary: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. Existing latent action models infer actions from visual transitions, but their representations often entangle the underlying action with irrelevant visual variations, limiting transfer across embodiments. We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner. Our approach extracts compact latent actions from the video model's rich spatiotemporal features, compressing each latent video frame by 300times (1{,200 rightarrow 4} tokens). In addition, by leveraging the video model's generative prior, these latent actions capture action-relevant dynamics disentangled from visual appearance. The resulting latent space serves as a shared action interface across embodiments (human and robot), environments, and action parameterizations. On LARY-Bench, DreamX achieves state-of-the-art performance among latent action models. Moreover, actions encoded in one setting remain effective in another: the latent space supports any-to-any video transfer and zero-shot action transfer across diverse embodiments and environments. Furthermore, this shared interface also enables policy learning in a compact latent action space, reducing the computational cost of video-diffusion-based policies.
items.title_zh: DreamX：视频扩散模型作为通用潜在动作学习器
items.summary_zh: 现有模型难以从视觉变化中分离出动作本质。DreamX利用预训练视频扩散模型提取紧凑的潜在动作，压缩视频帧并捕捉动作相关动态。该模型在LARY-Bench上表现优异，支持跨具身和环境的动作迁移。

items.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
items.summary: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review the literature, develop a research plan, conduct research and experiments, and produce structured outputs and scientific manuscripts. Combining deterministic verifiers with expert-authored rubrics, FrontierPhysics evaluates whether agents' research is correct and publishable. Across 22 models in 26 configurations, no configuration passes more than 46 of its 168 rollouts. Manual review of agent trajectories shows that frontier agents' main weaknesses are insufficiently rigorous reasoning and limited expert intuition, rather than gaps in physics knowledge or execution errors.
items.title_zh: FrontierPhysics：端到端物理研究智能体评测

items.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
items.summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.
items.title_zh: Turns Matter：通过回合级信用推进流媒体视频强化学习
items.summary_zh: 现有方法在流媒体视频理解中存在奖励设计单一和轨迹级反馈不匹配的问题。TurnWise提出回合级GRPO框架，通过沉默完成前缀评分分离学习信号，并平均回合内损失。实验表明该方法优于先前RL方法。

items.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
items.summary: Coding agents solve repository issues through long sequences of exploration, editing, and validation. These trajectories are increasingly used as post-training data, so how they are collected shapes what the trained model learns. A common approach is to sample multiple trajectories independently for each issue and then select or curate them. However, as more trajectories are sampled independently, later trajectories become increasingly redundant, even though earlier trajectories could guide where subsequent collection effort should be spent. A natural way to use this history is to expose it to the coding agent as advice. But training on such trajectories can make the model rely on advice that is unavailable at test time, creating a train-test mismatch. Instead, we argue that history should guide where collection effort is spent, while the coding agent decides what to generate. We introduce SWE-Trail, a trajectory collector that uses earlier trajectories to guide subsequent collection while keeping that history outside the coding agent's context. During a new rollout, SWE-Trail uses history to identify a state where additional collection effort may be useful. There, the coding agent proposes candidate next actions from its ordinary context, and SWE-Trail briefly executes them from the same checkpoint to decide which route continues. We evaluate collection approaches by training student models on the trajectories they produce. For a 124B student initialized from Ling-3.0-flash…
items.title_zh: SWE-Trail：编码智能体训练的历史引导轨迹收集
items.summary_zh: 现有轨迹收集方法导致数据冗余且存在训练测试不匹配。SWE-Trail利用历史轨迹指导后续收集，同时保持历史在智能体上下文之外。该方法通过执行候选动作选择有效路径，提升了学生模型的训练效果。

items.title: You don't need long context
items.summary: Later tokens are costlier to generate than earlier tokens. On frontier open weight models, the disparity in cost may rise to as much as 7x. Through frequent compaction, we show across a broad range of long-horizon and long-input tasks that frontier language models sacrifice little to no task accuracy when maintaining short contexts. We further demonstrate that LLM performance does not collapse on long-horizon software engineering tasks even when taking at most one action per context, and based on that we outline the concept of semantic state space models (SSSMs). Our findings question the need for long-context language models.
items.summary_zh: 后期令牌生成成本更高，但通过频繁压缩可保持短上下文。研究发现前沿语言模型在长任务中牺牲极少精度，且在软件工程任务中性能不崩溃。这质疑了长上下文语言模型的必要性。

a318e9774b7d.body: DreamX 利用预训练视频扩散模型提取紧凑的潜在动作，压缩视频帧并捕捉动作相关动态，在 LARY-Bench 上表现优异。

f9784a9ca794.headline: FrontierPhysics：端到端物理研究智能体评测
f9784a9ca794.body: FrontierPhysics引入56个由物理学家设计的任务，要求智能体完成文献综述、实验和论文撰写。

b31383435735.headline: Turns Matter：通过回合级信用推进流媒体视频强化学习
b31383435735.body: TurnWise提出回合级GRPO框架，通过沉默完成前缀评分分离学习信号，并平均回合内损失。

371d331b4de8.headline: SWE-Trail：编码智能体训练的历史引导轨迹收集
371d331b4de8.body: SWE-Trail利用历史轨迹指导后续收集，同时保持历史在智能体上下文之外，提升了学生模型的训练效果。

810b2a45ab1a.body: 研究发现前沿语言模型在长任务中牺牲极少精度，且在软件工程任务中性能不崩溃，质疑了长上下文模型的必要性。

4873b47dbc96.headline: 何立峰调研科技创新与产业创新融合
4873b47dbc96.body: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰在北京调研，指出要强化科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
